# Going further {.unnumbered}

These short pages explain ideas that the weekly pages only mention. Each one is optional. Read a page when a week links to it and you want to know more, or when the idea comes up in your own analysis.

Every page has the same shape: what the idea is, why it happens, a worked example (usually from the [Student Life Survey](../course/dataset.qmd)), where it comes up in the course, and one or two readings.
